cases.customer_question: Is RF PHY testing required only when Bluetooth Low Energy (LE) is supported?
question_variants: Do we need RF PHY tests for BLE devices?
Is RF PHY testing tied to LE support?
When is RF PHY testing required in Bluetooth qualification?
Does Classic Bluetooth require RF PHY testing?
How to determine if RF PHY test is needed?
cases.actual_issue: Understanding the condition under which RF PHY testing is required, specifically its dependency on BLE (Low Energy) support.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The team wants to know when RF PHY testing is necessary. This test is not always required for all Bluetooth devices. The key factor is whether the device supports Bluetooth Low Energy.
cases.consultant_answer: RF PHY testing is required when the product supports Bluetooth Low Energy (LE). This can be confirmed by checking whether BLE is selected in the quotation or requirement request documentation.
cases.decision_logic: RF PHY testing is tied to LE radio functionality. If LE is implemented (as indicated in requirements such as a quotation request), RF PHY testing must be included.
cases.final_recommendation: Verify BLE support in the requirement or quotation documents. If BLE is included, plan for RF PHY testing.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Skipping RF PHY testing for LE devices can lead to incomplete qualification and test failure or rejection. Conversely, performing unnecessary tests increases cost and time.
